file_insights.changes_summary: Refactored production_order_list view to use centralized apply_list_filters utility
key_modifications: Added import for apply_list_filters and FilterConfig from apps.core.list_utils
Replaced manual search and status filtering logic with FilterConfig declarative approach
Extracted filter parameters (search, status) into FilterConfig objects
Updated context dictionary to use result dict from apply_list_filters function
file_insights.complexity_change: Reduced - manual filter logic replaced with utility function

patterns_discovered.description: Moving from imperative filter chains to declarative FilterConfig objects
patterns_discovered.benefit: Centralizes filter logic, improves maintainability and consistency across views
patterns_discovered.implementation: Using FilterConfig with param_name, filter_type, and filter_kwargs/search_fields

patterns_discovered.description: Extracting common view patterns (search, filtering, pagination) into reusable utilities
patterns_discovered.benefit: Reduces code duplication across multiple views, enforces consistent filtering behavior

patterns_discovered.description: apply_list_filters returns structured result dict with 'queryset' and 'filter_values' keys
patterns_discovered.benefit: Consistent interface across all views using this utility
patterns_discovered.usage: context['orders'] = result['queryset'], filter values extracted from result['filter_values']

gotchas_discovered.description: filter_kwargs uses template string '{value}' placeholder for dynamic value substitution
gotchas_discovered.example: filter_kwargs={'status': '{value}'} - the {value} placeholder must match the param_name
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Follow existing FilterConfig examples; ensure param_name matches the GET parameter key

gotchas_discovered.description: search_fields must use Django ORM field lookup syntax including relationships
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Be aware that material__code assumes ForeignKey relationship; must match model structure

gotchas_discovered.description: filter_values are now nested in result dict instead of direct request.GET values
gotchas_discovered.example: Old: search = request.GET.get('search', '') | New: search = result['filter_values'].get('search', '')
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Update all context variables that previously came from request.GET to use result['filter_values']

gotchas_discovered.description: apply_list_filters handles pagination internally (page_size=20) - manual Paginator code removed
gotchas_discovered.impact: Pagination behavior is now handled by utility function, reducing visibility of pagination logic
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Trust the utility function; if custom pagination behavior needed, adjust page_size parameter

approach_outcome.refactoring_success: Successfully replaced 19 lines of manual filter/pagination logic with 11 lines of declarative FilterConfig approach
approach_outcome.code_quality_improvement: Reduced code duplication by centralizing filtering logic into reusable utility
approach_outcome.technical_debt_reduction: Eliminated manual Q object construction, manual pagination, and direct request.GET handling
approach_outcome.compatibility: Maintained all existing functionality including search (order_number, material__code, material__name), status filtering, and pagination
approach_outcome.testing_implications: Filtering behavior now delegated to apply_list_filters utility; unit tests should focus on FilterConfig setup rather than filter logic itself

recommendations.recommendation: Verify apply_list_filters utility properly handles empty search parameters and None values for optional filters
recommendations.rationale: Migration removes explicit handling of empty strings from request.GET

recommendations.recommendation: Create or update tests for production_order_list view to cover all filter combinations (search, status, pagination)
recommendations.rationale: Pagination logic moved to utility; ensure view-level tests still cover end-to-end filtering

recommendations.recommendation: Document FilterConfig structure and filter_type options (search vs field) for future developers
recommendations.rationale: New abstraction pattern requires understanding of FilterConfig parameters for consistent usage

recommendations.recommendation: Review other views in production app (and across codebase) for similar filter/pagination patterns to apply same refactoring
recommendations.rationale: This is a reusable pattern; applying it consistently improves overall codebase maintainability

recommendations.recommendation: Consider adding pagination info to context (current page, total pages) if templates depend on this data
recommendations.rationale: apply_list_filters may return additional pagination metadata that should be passed to templates
